product_metadata.title: Price and Kensington 2-Cup Teapot, Rockingham Brown
features: Made of beautiful and durable stoneware
Classic English shape; Rockingham brown color
description: Price and Kensington is well-known and much loved for their teapots. This durable stoneware teapot is made in the classic English shape. The shape of the teapot causes the tea leaves to be gently swirled around as boiling water is added, producing a rich, full flavored brewed pot of tea. Dishwasher and microwave safe. Capacity: 16-Ounce/500 ml. Rockingham brown.
